data.title: Jobcenter rejects application for initial furnishing of apartment
data.summary: Jobcenter Beispielkreis wrote on 10 April 2026 rejecting your application of 3 March 2026 for initial furnishing of your apartment. It treats the washing machine and wardrobe as replacements, and says a loan may be requested instead.
data.explanation: The Jobcenter has rejected your request for a grant for initial furnishing (Erstausstattung), because it considers the washing machine and wardrobe to be replacements, not first-time furnishing. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree; the app shows until when, by the deadline shown. It can be filed in writing or on record at the Jobcenter. Alternatively, you can apply for a loan under § 24 Abs. 1 SGB II. A counselling centre or social lawyer can help you decide.

items.title: Object to the rejection (Widerspruch)

date.text: binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe

items.action: File an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or on record with Jobcenter Beispielkreis if you disagree with the rejection.
items.consequence: After the deadline the rejection becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.

items.title: Consider applying for a loan
items.action: Consider applying for a loan under § 24 Abs. 1 SGB II for the washing machine and wardrobe.
items.quote: Hierfür kann ein Darlehen nach § 24 Abs. 1 SGB II beantragt werden.
